To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the basic reproduction number R 0 is the spectral radius of the matrix FV −1, where F and V are the matrices of new infections and transfers of infection, respectively.

the basic reproduction number is equal to the spectral radius of the Jacobian matrix of the vector of new infections evaluated at the disease-free equilibrium, which is equal to the largest eigenvalue of the next-generation matrix, which is equal the dominant eigenvalue in the characteristic equation of the next-generation operator evaluated at the disease free equilibrium.

the threshold parameter obtained from the Jacobian matrix is the same as the basic reproduction number obtained by the next generation matrix and that the basic reproduction number is a lower bound for the threshold parameter.

the spectral radius of the Jacobian matrix is equal to the basic reproduction number of a compartmental model.

the spectral radius of the Jacobian matrix of a system of ODEs can be used to obtain a threshold parameter, which is equivalent to the basic reproduction number for an epidemic model.
